text:
Type: stoneware cylinder planter
Use: holding an indoor plant; on the floor, a shelf or a side table; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: glazed stoneware with brushed streaked texture
Colors: dark grey-green, cream rim and interior
Shape: straight-sided cylinder with fine horizontal brushstroke lines, recessed base, medium size, simple
Feel: calm, earthy, understated
Goes with: warm wood, white walls, green plants, neutral textiles; mid-century or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Mid-Century 100% Stoneware Planter, 7.87"H, Dark Green
product.description: This beautiful 100% stoneware pot provides dimension and beauty whether holding a plant or not. The small size easily fits on a windowsill, desk, or bookshelf, bringing style to any room in the house. It also adds a lovely splash of color to any decor. 8.85" diameter x 7.87"H 100% stoneware This mid-century 100% stoneware planter fits nicely on a side table, desk, or bookshelf. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
